item.description:
Calmer keep card

The keep card now drops straight down out of the notch, holds still for ~2.5 seconds, and slides straight back up — no more rubber-band bounce or stretch.

Snappier capture + auto-update on launch

  • Checks for updates when you open Aura — no need to use “Check for Updates…” manually.
  • Tighter card — less empty space above the keep card.
  • Quick peek — the card now slides down, lingers ~2.5s, and glides back into the notch. Hover it to keep it around.

The Keep card is back

When you copy something, the notch now slides a little “keep this?” card down automatically — with a clear Keep button — instead of just nudging. Click Keep to save it, ✕ to dismiss, or ignore it and it quietly retracts. Hovering the card pauses the countdown.

Ask your Memory — semantic search

Aura's search is now semantic and on-device. It reads what you actually saved — text in screenshots (OCR), the body of articles behind your links, video titles & descriptions — and ranks your library by meaning, so “that documentary about money” or “everything I saved about investing” just works.

  • Natural-language search — hybrid keyword + on-device embeddings (NaturalLanguage), 100% local.
  • AI answer — on Apple Silicon with Apple Intelligence, press Return to get a short written answer grounded in your results (Foundation Models).
  • Richer indexing — image OCR, link article text, PDF text, and YouTube/Vimeo metadata.
  • Automatic updates — Aura now updates itself (this is the first build with it).
